messages:
chris-sales: ACME POC blocked: users not syncing and SSO failing. Can we triage quickly?
olivia-iam: Got it. What error do they see for SCIM? 401 or 400?
jordan-acme: We saw 401 on SCIM POSTs earlier, then after rotating the token now 400: missing emails[0].value.
olivia-iam: 401 usually token mismatch. Make sure the SCIM Bearer token in your app matches the one from Admin > Integrations > SCIM. For the 400, map email -> emails[0].value or include userName. Example payload: `{"userName":"j@acme","emails":[{"value":"j@acme","primary":true}]}`.
zach-eng-platform: On the SSO side they reported "SP metadata mismatch". We recently changed the POC SP entity. We can temporarily accept their old entity ID but need a config flip.
deploy-bot: Config change requested by zach-eng-platform. Change ID cfg-90021. Status: pending.
zach-eng-platform: Flipped alias to accept old and new SP IDs for ACME tenant. cfg-90021 deployed.
jordan-acme: After token and mapping updates, SCIM now syncs 38 users. SSO login also works. Thanks!
chris-sales: Great — olivia, can you send a one-paragraph note about SCIM token rotation for their security team? I'll update the POC ticket.
olivia-iam: Sent: "SCIM tokens are tenant-scoped tokens issued from the Redwood Admin console. Tokens can be rotated at any time; rotation immediately invalidates prior tokens. Token usage is logged and auditing events are available on request."
chris-sales: Perfect, closing thread.
